description: This file defines the interface for the Dynamic Bass Enhancement (LVDBE) module, including types, structures, function prototypes, and constants used for controlling and processing bass enhancement effects in audio processing.

methods.name: LVDBE_Memory
methods.description: Allocates or frees memory for the LVDBE module, returning memory requirements or allocated addresses.

methods.name: LVDBE_Init
methods.description: Creates or re-initializes an LVDBE instance with specified memory and capabilities.

methods.name: LVDBE_GetParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current parameters of the LVDBE instance.

methods.name: LVDBE_GetCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities of the LVDBE instance.

methods.name: LVDBE_Control
methods.description: Sets or updates parameters of the LVDBE instance.

methods.name: LVDBE_Process
methods.description: Processes input audio data to apply bass enhancement effects.
